upcoming.title: Becoming Her
upcoming.subtitle: The Woman You're Meant to Be
upcoming.summary: Pause, reflect, and reconnect with the woman emerging within you — identity, courage, and becoming.
upcoming.description:
After seasons of survival and healing, many women arrive at a powerful moment of reflection: Who am I becoming now?

Becoming Her is an invitation to pause, reflect, and reconnect with the woman emerging within you. Through honest conversations, shared experiences, and guided reflection, we will explore identity, courage, and the journey of becoming.

This gathering creates a space for women to transform past pain into personal power and begin stepping more confidently into the next chapter of their lives.

Come as you are. Leave with clarity, connection, and renewed confidence in the woman you are becoming.

galleryImages.alt: Women in circle at a gathering

exploreBullets: Understanding emotional wounds and how they shape identity
Breaking generational patterns and societal expectations
Stepping into the woman you are becoming
upcoming.closingNote: Women leave feeling lighter, clearer, and more connected to themselves and each other.

past.title: Transform and Thrive
past.subtitle: From Survival to Thriving
past.summary: The first Elysian House gathering — from surviving to choosing to thrive.
past.description:
Transform and Thrive was the first Elysian House gathering: a curated, intimate space for women ready to move beyond surviving and begin the journey of truly thriving.

Women came together in a room built on safety, honesty, and shared experience. Through guided reflection and open conversation, they began to explore what it means to not just manage their lives, but to choose them — intentionally.

What started as one room became the foundation of a growing community of women finding their way home to themselves.
past.experienceBlock: An intimate gathering where women arrived as strangers and left as a community. Honest conversations, shared stories, and a space where no performance was required — only presence.
